question: Should the standalone nemotron-mlx branch be delivered after removing the non-Nemotron uv conflict pairs and regenerating the lock?

artifacts.summary: Validation cycle 2 reproduced AC-5 to AC-8 independently and closed the real-time-feed and Mandarin gaps. Rejected on scope: pyproject.toml still carries canary by diarization-diart and diarization-diart by diarization-sortformer, inherited from the stacked branch, which the captain directed be removed so the uv delta stays on this branch. Removal is safe: a re-lock from pristine main with only the Nemotron addition leaves the 39-package nvidia set, cuda-toolkit 13.0.2 and torch 2.11.0+cu129 identical with zero version differences; the cost is two transitive entries and miniaudio 1.71 to 1.73. Also outstanding: AC-5..AC-8 sit in the ideation report instead of the top-level criteria block, so the AC scan returns none.
